purpose: Bounded 1С:Совместимо connector foundation under PC-CROP Federal Accounting / 1С / ЭДО. Restores the canonical seven-command protocol, fail-closed validation, self-discovery, one-time pairing and certification evidence. No Prisma, production, runtime credential, provider traffic or Connection Center maturity change in this slice.
requiredInvariants: 1С customer environments initiate outbound HTTPS; the platform does not require inbound Internet access into a customer 1С host.
Direct DBMS access to a 1С information base is forbidden; only documented 1С mechanisms may be used by a configuration adapter.

The v1 remote-operation allowlist is exactly UPSERT_COUNTERPARTY, CREATE_SALES_DRAFT, CREATE_PURCHASE_DRAFT, CREATE_CORRECTION_DRAFT, GET_DOCUMENT_STATUS, PUSH_PAYMENT_STATUS and GET_REFERENCE_CANDIDATES.
Unknown commands and unknown payload fields fail closed; no arbitrary SQL, arbitrary 1С code, generic RPC, database dump or unrestricted read is admitted.

Pairing material is high-entropy, only salted hash material belongs in the persistent shape, and the default pairing lifetime is ten minutes; this slice does not persist or issue a production credential.

One 1С information base may expose several legal entities, but a binding names one exact platform organization and one exact discovered 1С organization; discovery does not authorize sibling legal entities.
AUTO_POST is fail-closed to CREATE_DRAFT unless separate acceptance evidence exists for the exact installation and configuration version.
Network timeout or ambiguous external effect becomes UNKNOWN and requires reconciliation before retry; it is never promoted to success.
Compatibility/discovery evidence cannot mark ONE_C ADAPTER_READY, TEST or CONFIRMED_LIVE by itself; ONE_C.adapterImplemented remains false in this slice.
Generated cryptographic inventory must stay reproducible after adding production TypeScript and may not be bypassed or weakened.
No new mandatory recurring cost is introduced.
